value.rationale: The paper-motivated anomaly of 40 length-two elements at F5 was previously empirical. A complete algebraic criterion now identifies its mechanism, resolves the entire single-commutator image over arbitrary characteristic-five fields, reveals a square-class-dependent width phase, and supplies an infinite-family exact count q(q-1)^2/2. Representation length, unlike the known generated ideal, is a genuinely finer algebraic question; no arbitrary parameter slice or cosmetic numerical gain is needed.
